tools.name: ardent_aave_supply_simulate
tools.description: Simulate supplying an asset into Aave V3 on Sepolia. The server compiles approve -> Pool.supply as an ERC-4337 batch.

amount_raw.description: Raw token base-unit amount. Provide either amount or amount_raw.

tools.name: ardent_aave_supply_execute
tools.description: Execute supplying an asset into Aave V3 on Sepolia.

amount_raw.description: Raw token base-unit amount. Provide either amount or amount_raw.

tools.name: ardent_aave_withdraw_simulate
tools.description: Simulate withdrawing an asset from Aave V3 on Sepolia. Amount may be a number string or max.

to.description: Optional recipient address; defaults to agent wallet

tools.name: ardent_aave_withdraw_execute
tools.description: Execute withdrawing an asset from Aave V3 on Sepolia.

to.description: Optional recipient address; defaults to agent wallet

tools.name: ardent_aave_repay_simulate
tools.description: Simulate repaying Aave V3 debt on Sepolia. The server compiles approve -> Pool.repay as an ERC-4337 batch.

on_behalf_of.description: Optional debt owner; defaults to agent wallet

tools.name: ardent_aave_repay_execute
tools.description: Execute repaying Aave V3 debt on Sepolia.

on_behalf_of.description: Optional debt owner; defaults to agent wallet

tools.name: ardent_aave_borrow_simulate
tools.description: Simulate borrowing from Aave V3 on Sepolia. The server checks projected health factor before simulating the Pool.borrow call.

on_behalf_of.description: Optional debt owner; defaults to agent wallet

min_health_factor.description: Minimum projected health factor after borrow; default 1.05; must be at least 1.0

tools.name: ardent_aave_borrow_execute
tools.description: Execute borrowing from Aave V3 on Sepolia after projected health-factor guard.

on_behalf_of.description: Optional debt owner; defaults to agent wallet

min_health_factor.description: Minimum projected health factor after borrow; default 1.05; must be at least 1.0
